name: Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc.
summary: Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc. engages in the research, design, manufacture, and sale of power semiconductor components and related modules in Taiwan and internationally. It also offers MOSFET, DrMOS, and AEC-Q101 integrated circuits. Its solutions are used for applications in PC and server, automotive, information and communication, industrial automation control, LCD monitor, batrery module, handheld device, motor drive, and switching power supply. Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan. The company operates as a subsidiary of Anpec Electronics Corporation.
